metaShifts.description: Systematic nerfs to core support items (Guardian Greaves heal -25, Mekansm heal -25, Pipe barrier -25, Holy Locket amplification -5%) combined with utility item nerfs (Gleipnir health -50, Rod of Atos health -25, Solar Crest armor -2) creates a cascade failure in support survivability and teamfight impact. This reverses 7.37b's support power normalization by making support itemization significantly weaker.

After 7.37b eliminated Kaya stacking, this patch provides direct buffs to intelligence cores: Zeus damage +15/20/25/30 and mana cost reduction, Lina Combustion threshold buff, Tinker Defense Matrix early game improvement, Necrophos base int +1. This attempts to restore viability to intelligence cores without returning the broken Kaya mechanics.

Targeted buffs to specific agility carries (Anti-Mage Blink cooldown -1.5s at all levels, Drow Marksmanship +10 damage, PL illusion duration buffs, Riki Backstab early game +0.15 multiplier) while nerfing problematic elements (Ember Flame Guard -5 DPS, Windranger base agi -2). This fine-tunes the carry pool without major systemic changes.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Lightning Bolt damage increase (+15/20/25/30) and Nimbus mana cost reduction (-50) makes Zeus's double ultimate combo significantly more impactful and sustainable, especially with the cheaper Nimbus cast enabling more frequent Refresher usage.

Blink cooldown reduction (13.5/11/8.5/6s to 12/10/8/6s) synergizes perfectly with Manta Style's split-push and escape mechanics, allowing AM to Blink more frequently between illusion pushes and escape scenarios.

Spirit Lance illusion duration increase (2/4/6/8s to 3.5/5/6.5/8s) combined with Phantom Rush agility bonus during rush creates longer-lasting, higher-damage illusions that benefit more from Diffusal's mana burn and slow.
Marksmanship proc damage increase (+10 at all levels) amplifies the value of Hurricane Pike's attack range and positioning, as each proc from the extended range deals significantly more damage.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Omniknight's Purification heal nerf (-25 heal from Guardian Greaves, -25 from Mekansm) combined with Repel duration reduction (6s to 5s) and Hammer of Purity damage nerfs creates a cascade where his core healing item is weaker while his protective abilities are also diminished.

Sven's Warcry duration nerf (10s to 8s) reduces the window for Solar Crest's armor manipulation synergy, while Solar Crest's own armor bonus reduction (7 to 5) makes the item less effective for Sven's teamfight initiation timing.

Sand King's base strength (-1) and Caustic Finale damage nerfs combined with Gleipnir's health reduction (-50) and Eternal Chains damage nerf (-15) significantly reduces his teamfight survivability and follow-up damage potential.

Ringmaster's movement speed nerf (315 to 310) and Strongman Tonic scaling reduction (1.5 to 1 per level) combined with Rod of Atos health reduction (300 to 275) makes his positioning and survivability significantly worse for his combo-dependent playstyle.

Carry.explanation: Blink cooldown reduction (13.5/11/8.5/6s to 12/10/8/6s) significantly improves his farming efficiency and escape potential, making him more viable as a position 1 carry in the current meta where mobility is crucial.

Marksmanship proc damage increase (+10 at all levels) provides substantial DPS improvement for a carry who relies on consistent right-click damage output, making her more competitive in late-game scenarios.
Spirit Lance illusion duration buffs (2/4/6/8s to 3.5/5/6.5/8s) and Phantom Rush agility application during rush significantly improve his farming speed and teamfight presence as a carry.

Mid.explanation: Lightning Bolt damage increase (+15/20/25/30) and Nimbus mana cost reduction (-50) make him a much stronger mid laner with better wave clear, harassment, and teamfight impact throughout all game phases.
Combustion damage threshold increase (150 to 175) makes her more survivable in mid lane trades and teamfights, while the Light Strike Array nerf is minimal compared to the survivability gain.
Base damage increase (+2) improves his laning phase significantly, making last-hitting and harassment more effective for a hero who needs strong early game farm to scale.

Offlane.explanation: Skewer damage increase (75/150/225/300 to 80/160/240/320) and Shockwave slow talent buff (+0.5s to +0.75s) improve his initiation and teamfight control as an offlaner.
Base health regen increase (0.25 to 0.5) significantly improves her laning sustainability as an offlaner, allowing her to trade more effectively and stay in lane longer.

SoftSupport.explanation: Hex cast range increase (550/575/600/625 to 575/600/625/650) improves his initiation potential as a position 4, though the talent nerf is a minor trade-off.
Shackles cooldown reduction (16/14/12/10s to 13/12/11/10s) makes him more effective as a position 4 with more frequent disable availability.

HardSupport.explanation: Nightmare cast range increase (500/550/600/650 to 550/600/650/700) improves his positioning safety and initiation range as a position 5 support.
Ice Blast Frostbitten duration increase (10s to 10/11/12s) makes his ultimate more impactful in teamfights, providing longer healing prevention as a hard support.

Carry.explanation: Flame Guard DPS reduction (20/30/40/50 to 15/25/35/45) significantly hurts his farming speed and teamfight damage as a carry, making him less viable in the position 1 role.
While Spectral Dagger mana cost reduction is minor, the overall support item nerfs (Guardian Greaves, Mekansm) hurt team compositions built around protecting Spectre through the late game.

Mid.explanation: Base mana regen reduction (0.75 to 0.5) and Defense Matrix cast range nerf (700/750/800/850 to 700) hurt his laning sustainability and positioning as a mid laner.
Base agility reduction (19 to 17) hurts her last-hitting and attack speed in mid lane, though talent buffs provide some late-game compensation.

Offlane.explanation: Base strength reduction (22 to 21) and Caustic Finale damage nerfs (20/40/60/80 to 15/35/55/75) significantly reduce his laning presence and farming ability as an offlaner.
Warcry duration reduction (10s to 8s) hurts his teamfight window and farming efficiency as an offlane Sven, reducing his impact in the role.
Base movement speed reduction (310 to 305) hurts his positioning and initiation potential as an offlaner who relies on mobility for effective engagement.

SoftSupport.explanation: Movement speed nerf (315 to 310), Strongman Tonic scaling reduction (1.5 to 1), and Wheel of Wonder timer nerfs significantly reduce his effectiveness as a position 4 support.
Acorn Shot slow duration reduction (0.35s to 0.3s) reduces her harassment and setup potential as a position 4 support.

HardSupport.explanation: Repel duration reduction (6s to 5s), Hammer of Purity damage nerfs, and the broader support item ecosystem collapse (Guardian Greaves, Mekansm nerfs) severely impact his effectiveness as a position 5.
Base damage reduction (-2) hurts his laning phase as a position 5, making harassment and last-hitting more difficult in an already challenging role.
